scope: Public source, knowledge resources, build inputs and packaged runtime; private operator profiles and artifacts are outside distribution
removed_categories: Contributor chat inventory and request-count history
Personal placement preferences and copied-target context
Contributor manual restoration, receiver reaction and extension installation anecdotes
Personal message choices and active preset address in historical public narratives
Local user-profile paths embedded in assemblies and portable debug symbols
retained_categories: General device operations with explicit caller inputs
Manufacturer documentation and pinned implementation references
Licence notices, public technical attribution and source hashes
Model/firmware-specific qualification, aggregate results, negative observations and incomplete-run limits
Clearly synthetic software fixtures, independently of operator setup
controls: Build path mapping uses a portable virtual source root
Public input and completed bundle scans are enforced by packaging
Independent archive scan covers text, PE metadata and portable PDBs, including UTF-16 path strings
Synthetic regression checks reject private artifact types, chat records and profile paths while permitting public provenance
Knowledge validation checks source links, capability coverage, evidence labels and portable references
limits: Pattern scans supplement human curation; they cannot establish the reusable meaning of every sentence
Model/firmware scope and aggregate validation results are intentionally retained and do not establish universal hardware compatibility
This audit does not change or erase an operator's private profiles, backups or recovery records
